title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 30
description: Ten questions on Numbers 30: the laws about vows and pledges made by men and women.

questions.text: To whom did Moses speak the laws about vows?
questions.explanation: Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel about what Yahweh had commanded.

questions.text: What must a man do when he vows a vow to Yahweh?
questions.explanation: He shall not break his word, but do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.

answers.text: Pay a ransom to be free of it
Not break his word, but do all he has said
Confirm it before a priest within seven days

questions.text: If a young woman in her father's house makes a vow and her father says nothing, what happens?
questions.explanation: If her father hears her vow and says nothing to her, then all her vows and every pledge shall stand.

answers.text: She must repeat them before Moses

questions.text: If a father forbids his daughter's vow on the day he hears it, what does Yahweh do?
questions.explanation: None of her vows shall stand, and Yahweh will forgive her, because her father has forbidden her.

answers.text: He requires a sin offering from her
He makes her father bear her iniquity
He lets the vow stand anyway

questions.text: What happens when a husband forbids his wife's vow on the day he hears it?
questions.explanation: If her husband forbids her in the day that he hears it, he makes void her vow, and Yahweh will forgive her.

answers.text: She must pay its value in silver

questions.text: What does the chapter say about the vow of a widow or a divorced woman?
questions.explanation: Everything with which a widow or a divorced woman has bound her soul shall stand against her.

answers.text: Everything she bound herself to shall stand
Her former husband may cancel it
It becomes void after a year

questions.text: Who may establish or make void a wife's vow or binding oath to afflict her soul?
questions.explanation: Every vow and binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.

questions.text: What is the result if a husband says nothing to his wife from day to day about her vows?
questions.explanation: If her husband says nothing to her from day to day, he establishes all her vows, because he said nothing in the day that he heard them.

questions.text: What happens if a husband makes his wife's vows void some time after he has heard them?
questions.explanation: If he makes them null and void after he has heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.

questions.text: Between whom are the statutes of this chapter, according to its last verse?
questions.explanation: These are the statutes between a man and his wife, and between a father and his daughter in her youth in her father's house.

answers.text: A master and his servant, and a buyer and a seller
A priest and a Levite, and a judge and a witness
A man and his wife, and a father and his daughter
A king and his people, and a brother and his sister
